buffers 0.1.1 — manual upstream license evidence

Upstream author: James Halliday <mail@substack.net> (http://substack.net)

License: MIT/X11 (MIT), declared by exact upstream commit
1b745ee35d33eb166e15ef1866073a07c6d7de87.

The locked npm package omits its license field and standalone LICENSE.
Its runtime/examples/tests are byte-identical to the licensed upstream tree;
package.json and README differ only by added MIT/X11 declarations.
See buffers-0.1.1-provenance.json for exact hashes and primary source links.
No Debian packaging files or dependency code changes are included.
